verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an official, agent-agnostic MCP server: "choose your agent, connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away". It can be self-deployed, and a probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. The evidence is all first-party marketing copy. missing for 10: concrete setup and tool-reference documentation (supported tools, transport, auth flow), independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably.
